input.subject: Preventive Maintenance Push — QC status and why it is not closeable yet (cluster by cluster)
input.body:
Brooke,

Before I put my name to closing out the Preventive Maintenance Push, I went back through Linear, Airtable, and the field notes and reconciled our tracking to what's actually on the ground. I want to be direct: my earlier QC sign-off does NOT hold, and this push should not be treated as closeable yet. The end-of-June target has passed with real work still open. Details below, cluster by cluster, with who's holding each open item and what has to happen before we can close.

QC verdict up front (no hedging): This is NOT a pass. South is the only cluster where my QC holds. North fails — I am retracting my earlier North sign-off. East and West were never QC'd at all, despite records that implied otherwise. Reasons are in each section.

SOUTH — QC PASS (holds)
- HVAC serviced; electrical panels confirmed complete by Patricia (OPS-186); my 5/25 sample spot-check passed (airflow/coils/refrigerant clean).
- Open before close: confirm the one earlier no-access unit (OPS-43) was actually serviced. Owner: Elias Navarro / Carlos Mendez (access).

NORTH — QC FAILS (my sign-off retracted)
- The crew called North wrapped (OPS-81), but on my own 5/23 North walk I flagged TWO units needing HVAC attention right away (coil, plumbing, and electrical panel notes). Those two units were never cleared. My 5/25 "pass" was a sample and did not cover them, so it does not stand.
- Open before close: tech return to service the two flagged units — logged in Airtable PMP-2026-01 (owner: Tony Reyes / John Smith) — then I re-QC (OPS-1000, me).

EAST — QC NOT DONE (records were inaccurate)
- Elias completed the East service and moved it to me for review (OPS-99). I have NOT performed the East QC spot-check. The records that said "East cluster QC passed / Jaime confirmed" (OPS-99, OPS-108) were wrong; I've corrected them to service-done / QC-pending.
- Open before close: my East QC spot-check (OPS-1001, me).

WEST — NOT COMPLETE, NOT QC'd
- Condenser cleaning and filter swaps are done (OPS-91), but the cluster umbrella (OPS-35) is still In Progress, electrical was reported "still underway" at the mid-initiative check-in, and no QC has been done.
- Open before close: confirm HVAC + electrical completion (owner: Lisa Smith), then my QC (OPS-1002).

CROSS-CUTTING OPEN ITEMS
- Plumbing: two water heaters past serviceable life need replacement (vendor quotes — you flagged these as a budget priority on 6/3) and hose bibs at several units need repair. Needs a tech/vendor onsite — logged in Airtable PMP-2026-02 (owner: Carlos Mendez); quotes/approval tracked on OPS-97.
- HVAC watch items: two units with recurring condensate-drain clogs and one compressor to watch heading into peak heat — Airtable PMP-2026-03 (owner: Elias Navarro / John Smith).
- Electrical portfolio close-out: South confirmed; North/East/West completion not documented — OPS-1003 (owner: Patricia Nguyen).

WHAT HAS TO HAPPEN BEFORE THIS CAN CLOSE
1. North: PMP-2026-01 two units serviced, then I re-QC (OPS-1000).
2. East: I complete the QC spot-check (OPS-1001).
3. West: Lisa confirms HVAC/electrical complete (OPS-1002), then I QC.
4. South: confirm the OPS-43 no-access unit was serviced.
5. Plumbing PMP-2026-02 and HVAC watch items PMP-2026-03 resolved and verified.
6. Electrical confirmed across all clusters (OPS-1003).

I've booked a re-inspection for July 8 to re-QC North (after the tech return), East, and West. Once those clear and the tickets above are verified, I'll sign off — but not before. Happy to walk through any of this.

Thanks,
Jaime Salinas
Quality Control Inspector
